text_block_list.text:
The pack approaches the final corner!
Now, the Victoria Mile!
Who will claim the glorious Queen's crown—?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to... become the Queen...!
---ngh!! I AM GOING TO DO IIIIIIIT!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (—In that moment, I finally understood.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (Her heartfelt cry overlapped with Messiah-san at the Shuka Sho—)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(What "brilliance" is born from.
And why I was never able to find it all this time.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: It's "resolve."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"To be precise—'the resolve to bet everything on that single race.'
Both of you possessed that, and—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: It is the true nature of the "radiance" I never possessed.
choice_data_list: The resolve to stake everything on that one race...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...Come to think of it, both of you stated it clearly before taking on the race.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I intend to take on this challenge, wagering all that I am.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm putting everything on that race.
No matter what it takes, I'm going to etch my name into history.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—I had heard her answer.
And I had received her feelings, too.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: However, I couldn't understand. That was likely—
choice_data_list: —Because that wouldn't even cross your mind.
—Because it's something you'd never even consider.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
It was a surprisingly simple reason.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: The meaning of words like 'wager everything' and 'stake' inside me were completely different from the meaning of their words.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
If I can win this race,
whatever comes after doesn't matter.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The throbbing in my legs and the ache in my lungs are trivial.
Even if this body of mine were to rot away—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: If it's for victory, I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...No matter what words I may use to spur myself on,
I have never run with those kinds of feelings."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: The destination is far away, so I can't afford to burn myself out completely right now—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: That voice of reason always kicks in.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That is why they likely could not grasp it.
The sheer depth of determination those words carried.

Still, I've found the answer...!
Now it's just a matter of how to impart it
to Cesario, but—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Before moving forward, there's one problem.

The reason she doesn't think fleetingly is for
the sake of that distant future she must reach—
It is also because, in the first place, that is simply her nature.

In other words, unless there's a truly compelling reason,
one couldn't muster such "do-or-die determination."
choice_data_list: You and I just don't mix at all...!
You and I just don't mix at all...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
That's right.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I hope there's some kind of good opportunity. Though when I say opportunity—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
......
That's quite a difficult task.

After that, the two of us thought about it for a while,
but time merely ticked away in vain.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we call it a day for now?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry.
Though I admit it is a bit frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
If we keep pressing forward, the way will open up.
I know that very well by now.
And so, the Victoria Mile, where Daring Heart's soul resonated, drew to a close.

Results can be cruel at times.
Yet, it is precisely because of that, a new future is forged.
The "brilliance" born that day passed the baton along once more.

Afterward, following her suggestion,
the Queen Elizabeth II Cup was chosen as our next target race.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Though she's currently resting—Sweep Tosho achieved great success in the Senior GⅠ races last year, drawing immense attention to the Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I've heard talk that
she'll be running in the race.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "...The Umamusume challenging for this year's Triple Tiara are naturally bound to enter as well."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The top rankers from both the older and younger generations...
I want to beat girls like them in a race.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I hoped that somewhere in all of that...
I might find an answer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: How about it?

A race against powerhouses across different generations...
I'm sure we'll have so much to gain from it.
choice_data_list: Of course, I'm all for it!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
The Queen Elizabeth II Cup is right around the corner after summer ends.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Until then, let us continue
taking things day by day, step by step."

Our next target race: the Queen Elizabeth II Cup—
And so began the days of racing beneath the summer sky.
